snippet.title: Giggleland - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
The first gameplay trailer for Giggleland. Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3370490/Giggleland/

Featuring a 6-hour story told across 8 chapters and a full cast of voice actors, Giggleland is a psychological horror game like you've never experienced before.
